County Treasurer
The County Treasurer is responsible for the collection and distribution of tax roll levies and is also the custodian of County and related funds including the banking of such funds. The Shiawassee County Treasurer invests all surplus monies and distributes funds to schools, townships, cities, and villages. In addition, the treasurer is a member of the County Election Commission and the Plat Board by virtue of the office she holds. The Treasurer is elected to a 4 year term by the voters of Shiawassee County on a partisan ballot in the general November election.
